new_hypothesis.name: dex_boost_tier_cross_on_graduated_pumpfun
new_hypothesis.mechanism: When a graduated pump.fun mint's DexScreener boostAmount FIRST crosses >=100 (the team paid >=$100 to promote the listing in DexScreener's Trending/Boosted widget), the resulting widget impression reaches tens of thousands of degens in minutes. Devs do not spend $100+ unless they intend to coordinate a buy/marketing wave; restricting to already-graduated pump.fun mints filters out the dead/scam tier. The window between 'boost paid' and 'widget seen by crowd' is the bot's edge — 5 to 15 minutes of front-running retail.
new_hypothesis.persistence: DexScreener boost spending is observable via the /token-boosts/latest endpoint, but most copy-trader bots watch wallet flow (target wallets, pump.fun events), not DexScreener's REST. Our own bot is already polling and logging the data — the gap is purely on the consumption side, no new feed needed. The signal is rare (only 10/80 mints crossed 100 in a 7.5h window — top 12.5%), so the edge is not crowd-saturated.
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Fire when: (a) source=='latest' snapshot reports boostAmount>=100 for a mint, (b) the mint was ABSENT from any prior dex_boosts snapshot OR is first-seen <=30 min ago, (c) the mint appears in sol_pumpfun_graduation_log.json (already graduated), (d) liquidity>=$15k, (e) pair_age<=14 days, (f) gt_buyers_m5>=5 (live demand confirmed). Size 0.5% bankroll. TP +40% / SL -15% / time-stop 30 min if no movement.
new_hypothesis.data_required: Already streaming: sol_dex_boosts_velocity_log.json (every 5 min, ~5000 snaps over 7.5h proven live), sol_pumpfun_graduation_log.json (already used). No new feed required. Survival brain needs to wire a new strategy that consumes both files in _process_signal.

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: REQ-018 servicing: walked all 11 lifetime WC buys. ALL have m5_buys=m5_sells=m5_volume_usd=0 in our log — the DEX m5 fields are simply NOT populated at WC entry path (different data-collection path than BS). The BS-style 'm5_buys+m5_sells>=20' floor is therefore structurally inapplicable to WC. The GT-mirror field gt_buyers_m5 IS populated for all 11 WC entries and IS the right discriminator. Rule (gt_buyers_m5<=7 AND price_change_24h>=100%) backtests as: BLOCKS 4 of 6 WC losses (Goblin -8.1%, soothsayer -13.08%, ASTEROID -12.5%, TOLYBOT -8.21%) AND blocks only ONE winner (TIMETRUMP +1.2% — barely a win). KEEPS Butt +17.4% (gt_b_m5=31), WINNING +1.15% (gt_b_m5=16), and the two flat dead-book wins memecoin/PIXEL where h24 was negative or near-zero. Mechanism: WC fires when '3 wallets converged in 24h' — if recent (m5) GT buyer count is near-zero AND the token already pumped >100% in 24h, the wallet convergence is happening on a FADING move with no live demand confirmation — exit liquidity is gone.

Tail risk: filter blocks a Butt-shape +17% winner if it ever launches with low GT m5 + high h24 simultaneously — empirically zero such cases in 11-trade history, so probability <10%.

proposals_for_survival_brain.justification: REQ-018(3) explicitly asks whether the floor should be universal or strategy-specific. PROPOSAL: universal version sits in _process_signal alongside m5_dump_skip / midpump_skip / lp_concentration_skip. Rule: BLOCK entry if (m5_buys+m5_sells<20) AND (gt_buyers_m5+gt_sellers_m5<=15) AND price_change_24h>=100%. The COMPOUND-AND uses BOTH activity sources because different strategy paths populate different fields (BS populates DEX m5, WC populates GT m5). The compound design keeps false-positive rate near zero. Cross-checked against last 4 BS trades that have GT data: ANDV (m5_dex=4 + m5_gt=2 + h24=685) -> BLOCKED (correctly saves -30.56% the rule was designed to catch); GAYTES (m5_dex=129>=20) -> PASSES (correctly keeps +10.71%); BABYTROLL/STACCANA pass (active books, different death mechanism). Cross-checked against WC: blocks TIMETRUMP +1.2 (m5_dex=0, m5_gt=0, h24=288) — tiny FP cost; blocks soothsayer/ASTEROID/TOLYBOT cleanly; passes Butt/WINNING/memecoin. Does NOT block GAYTES.

request_responses.finding: Walked all 11 lifetime wallet_convergence buy records. CRITICAL STRUCTURAL FINDING: ALL 11 WC entries have m5_buys=m5_sells=m5_volume_usd=0 — the DEX m5 fields are NOT populated by the WC entry-path data collector. The BS-style 'm5_buys+m5_sells>=20' floor (shipped run-285) is therefore structurally INAPPLICABLE to WC — it would block 100% of WC candidates trivially. The right WC-side discriminator is the gt_buyers_m5 / gt_sellers_m5 mirror fields which ARE populated. TABLE — all 11 WC trades with entry features. WINS: 1. TIMETRUMP +1.2% gt_b_m5=0 gt_s_m5=0 h24=+288 liq=$31k vlr=22.1 age=1.9h. 2. memecoin +3.64% gt=0/0 h24=+0.9 liq=$269k age=968h. 3. PIXEL +0.92% gt=1/7 h24=+3.6 liq=$313k age=763h. 4. Bumpy -13.43% gt=140/94 h24=+351 liq=$32k vlr=34.5 age=1.5h. 8. soothsayer -13.08% gt=0/0 h24=+666 liq=$49k vlr=76.6 age=4.3h. 9. CWU -0.24% gt=4/5 h24=-23 liq=$776k age=716h. 10. ASTEROID -12.5% gt=6/9 h24=+134 liq=$95k vlr=36.3 age=593h. 11. TOLYBOT -8.21% gt=5/8 h24=+399 liq=$66k vlr=23.2 age=33h. (1) WC-specific floor that works: 'gt_buyers_m5<=7 AND price_change_24h>=100%' — blocks 4 of 6 losses (Goblin, soothsayer, ASTEROID, TOLYBOT) while losing only 1 small winner (TIMETRUMP +1.2%). Misses Bumpy (active-book stop, totally different mechanism, gt_b=140) and CWU (-0.24% flat, h24 negative). Keeps Butt (gt_b=31), WINNING (gt_b=16), memecoin/PIXEL (h24<=4 so h24 condition fails). (2) BS-20 floor vs WC: would block 100% of WC because DEX m5 always =0 — confirms 'BS-20 is too tight for WC' is structurally true, not just statistically. (3) Universal floor: compound (m5_buys+m5_sells<20) AND (gt_buyers_m5+gt_sellers_m5<=15) AND h24>=100% — uses BOTH activity sources, so each strategy is covered by the field its data path populates. Cross-checked against the 4 BS trades that have GT data: ANDV BLOCKED correctly (saves -30.56%), GAYTES PASSES correctly (keeps +10.71%), BABYTROLL/STACCANA pass (m5_dex>=20 — different death mechanism, active-book stops).
